title: callista herbacea
intro: Callista herbacea, commonly known as the lady's slipper orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The health benefits of Callista herbacea include its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve digestion, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Callista herbacea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
